function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad,
       SUM(pl.qty) AS total_qty,
       SUM(pl.amount_cad) / SUM(pl.qty) AS avg_actual_cost_per_unit_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period
ORDER BY pl.period","purpose":"Compute actual average purchase cost per unit (amount_cad/qty) for Aug and Sep 2026"}
